name: Gradon
long_description:
Gradon is Legora for the firms that design the world's buildings and infrastructure. Every road, bridge, water system and building starts with engineers, and there aren't nearly enough of them for everything the world needs to build. 

Gradon works across every workflow and tool an engineering firm runs on, from CAD design and calculations to full plan sets, and firms using it today have decreased average project times by more than 75%. We're building the platform that makes every engineer a 10x engineer, and with it, how the world gets built.

launches.title: Gradon: Legora for AEC (Architecture, Engineering, & Construction) firms
launches.tagline: The AI partner that makes every engineer 10x.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We're Nour and Yousef, co-founders of Gradon.

TL;DR: Gradon is the AI partner for AEC (Architecture, Engineering, Construction) firms. Engineers send it work the way they'd message a teammate, and it works across every workflow and tool the firm runs on, from CAD design and calculations, to reports and full plan sets. Firms using it today have decreased average project times by more than 75%.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aTg6ne4z_aU>

### How Gradon Works

* Message it like a teammate. Type or talk to it, or share your screen and walk it through a problem. It takes the task from there.
* It works the firm's way. Before Gradon ever touches a project, a firm brain is built, that learns the firm's past work and standards, so everything comes out just the way their team would do it.
* It works inside their tools, from CAD design, to analysis software, and anything in between. No new system to move into.
* Engineers stay in charge. Every deliverable comes back for review, and nothing changes until the engineer approves it.
* Every discipline. Civil, structural, MEP, architecture and more.

We're also each firm's AI partner, not just another piece of software. We fly out and work one-on-one with each firm's engineers until they're getting the most out of it. After that, we continuously host office hours, lunch-and-learns and more, to make sure firms always stay on the frontier.

### Why Now

AI is the biggest change to engineering since CAD. The demand to build has never been higher, and the number of engineers can't keep up. The next great engineering firms will be the ones where every engineer has Gradon behind them.

### Who We Are

We've known each other since kindergarten.

* Nour (CEO) studied Mechanical Engineering at Berkeley and worked as a mechanical design engineer. Before startups, he played professional academy soccer for the San Jose Earthquakes for 7 years.
* Yousef (CTO) graduated high school at 15, then earned a Bachelor's in EECS from Berkeley and a Master's from Stanford. He previously built FPGA infrastructure at Apple and worked on chip design at AMD.

### Our Ask

* If you run an engineering firm, book a demo today to see how Gradon can transform your firm to become AI-native.
* Intros to owners and principals at civil, structural, MEP or architecture firms. We compensate for successful referrals.

Reach us at [heygradon.com](http://heygradon.com) or [nour@heygradon.com](mailto:nour@heygradon.com)
